credits.title: Yang Datang dan Yang Pergi
credits.overview: Sinta (Dian Sastrowardoyo), the only daughter of Hartini (Retno Soetarto), inherits the family’s old Wiryo Guest House, a place that holds many memories from the past to the present. Amid the comings and goings of guests, Sinta is reunited with Banawan (Roy Sungkono), her childhood friend and the man she once loved. Ho

credits.title: A Silent Wait
credits.overview: A story of a married couple who find a reflection of their life through their neighbor, a young couple who ran off from their parents in the name of love.

credits.title: Pesantren: 3 Wishes 3 Loves
credits.overview: Huda, Rian, and Syahid are friends living in Islamic boarding school. They lost someone in their family and aspire to different things in their lives.
